_comment: GENERATED snapshot of the live public schema (table -> ordered column names).
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. scripts/schema-dictionary.py gates the single most
expensive recurring bug class in this repo -- a column name that does not
exist, which makes PostgREST reject the ENTIRE query and empty a page with
no visible error. Until now it could only build its dictionary from
supabase/*.sql -- from what the repo INTENDS the schema to be -- patched by a
hand-maintained KNOWN_LIVE_COLUMNS dict covering the places live had already
drifted. A hand-maintained patch list drifts again the moment live does.
This is what the database actually has. Regenerate whenever schema changes
are applied live: it is dated evidence, not a target. The query that
_relkinds: r,v,m,p (tables, views, materialized views, partitioned tables)
